analysis.visual_description: The loose leaf. Two lines, then one word, then a space. The red bundle at the far side, knotted, not touching the leaf. Candlelight. No face.
His hand between the leaf and the knot, not moving either. The knot is tight. No face.
Ink on the right forefinger. The leaf and the bundle in the same places. The candle shorter. He has stopped. No face.
